data.body: review-plan round 3: PASS, attestation signed (certified at e5bda753fa12). Six advisories recorded here for the implementer — do NOT edit the description before claim (that stales the signature): (1) strategy vocabulary is {static, jwt, introspection, proxy, custom} — read 'jwks' in Testing/AC-3 as the 'jwt' strategy (JWKSTokenVerifier is the class); (2) per-identity session-log growth: hints are per-session ids, so the log count grows with sessions, exactly as the CLI's per-session auto-rotation already does; the bound statement is about identity pairs, not a cap — acceptable, no retire path in this epic (idea pure-dashing-sardine family); (3) middleware ordering under the proxy strategy: wrap SessionHintMiddleware OUTSIDE ProxyAuthMiddleware (apply it last so it is outermost); it only sets a ContextVar, so order is not functionally load-bearing, but make it deterministic and assert it in test_mcp_auth.py; (4) log one DEBUG line when a hint is dropped (malformed/over-long) so operators can explain principal-only collapse — no metric; (5) the docs/session-id-shims.md correction must say 'observed exported in Claude Code 2.1.260 (verified in-session: echo $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID non-empty)', not 'guaranteed' — the Step-1 probe verdict is the authority; (6) AC wording: keep each AC's verifier test node exact.
